arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import math
july = 1.3
august = 1.4
september = 4.0

mean = (july + august) / 2
print(f'Mean: {mean}')

# Sample std dev with n-1 (for n=2, this is 1)
variance = ((july - mean)**2 + (august - mean)**2) / 1
std_dev = math.sqrt(variance)
print(f'Sample std dev: {std_dev}')

z_score = (september - mean) / std_dev
print(f'Z-score: {z_score}')
print(f'Z-score rounded: {round(z_score, 2)}')
print(f'Is unusual (z > 1.96): {z_score > 1.96}')
"
